claim: A person's feedback label (thumbs up/down, POST /ask/folios/:id/feedback) records the house's opt-out answer AT THE MOMENT THE LABEL IS GIVEN, independent of the question's own asked_while_opted_out, and the export leaves out a label given while opted out (founder, 2026-09-22, ADR 0145 round 6z, his pick verbatim: "Leave it out (Recommended)"; built 2026-09-28 from preserved snapshot 2f9a1e0d3, where the file was 20260922023000). Migration 20261203100000 adds ask_folio_labels.given_while_opted_out, derived by a BEFORE INSERT trigger from ask_training_opt_outs (a client value is overwritten), its derive function revoked from public, anon and authenticated. No written-once trigger: ask_folio_labels has no UPDATE code path (ReadingFolioStore.label() only inserts). ask_folio_training_export's pick(basis=person), compose and knowledge lateral joins each gain 'and not l.given_while_opted_out'; the re-ask lateral is untouched. Backfill, because /ask is live and production may hold labels: no opt-out row -> false; a row set at or before the label -> its opted_out; a row set after the label -> true (the earlier answer is unknown, so the label is left out). PGlite 2026-09-28 (KL6-label-opt-out-snapshot.mjs, re-run on main's five ask migrations over stub restaurants/users/ai_proposed_actions, not the full chain: 17 of 17 PASS): the founder's scenario 'opt-in ask -> opt-out -> label -> opt-in -> export excludes the label'; a forged false overwritten; an opted-in label exported; pick(person) and knowledge filtered; an earlier opted-in label surviving a later opted-out relabel; re-ask label and kind still exported; anon and authenticated cannot EXECUTE the derive function; the four backfill shapes; a re-run changes nothing. Mutation-tested 2026-09-28: dropping the compose filter fails 3 PGlite assertions and this verify; the snapshot's current-state backfill fails 1 PGlite assertion and this verify; dropping the revoke fails 1 PGlite assertion and this verify; each restored.
verify:
